title: Mode 0 V2X — Reproducibility Package (v2.0.0)
description: Code, simulation environment, results and figures for the revised manuscript "Mode 0: Architecture, Risk Taxonomy, and Standardization Pathway for RCU-Assisted V2X Safety Communication" (manuscript under review). Release 2.0 regenerates every learning-based result after correcting two implementation defects found during the revision (see the README); releases 1.x are superseded.
